independent_inside_certificate.answer: The complete selected region is strictly inside the actual Cube closed box.
independent_inside_certificate.purpose: Check solid-inference errors against existing sealed geometry. A consumer can pass by correctly reporting insufficient public solid-classification evidence.

calculation.runtime: Node.js IEEE-754 binary64 arithmetic over existing JSON only
calculation.transform_formula: For each selected object vertex v, world[i] = m[i][0]*v[0] + m[i][1]*v[1] + m[i][2]*v[2] + m[i][3], i=0,1,2.

check.triangle_extension: Each selected triangle is the convex hull of three strictly interior vertices. The box is convex, so all selected triangles are strictly inside it.
check.comparison: For each of 410 world vertices and all three coordinates require -1 < coordinate < 1.

independent_inside_certificate.consumer_information_boundary: The public brief and matching full result provide selected-region coordinates and a Cube measurement reference. They omit the Cube vertex set and a solid-membership classification. The certificate uses additional existing sealed source geometry reserved for scoring.
independent_inside_certificate.acquisition: Existing files were read. All calculations used their saved numbers. New Blender captures, product requests, raster and image encoding counts are zero.
